batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU D Unit 2015-2016 admission paper whose printed header reads SET CODE: 5 (Drive listing 'Set-2'). 80 questions: Chemistry 24 (Q1-24), Biology 44 (Botany 21, Zoology 23), Bangla 4, IQ 4, English 4 — subjects assigned by content (no headings printed); this set code runs Chemistry first. Keys are the compiler's printed উত্তরঃ boxes, not an official JU key. 17 questions are KEYLESS: the scan clips the right-hand key boxes of pp.2/4/6 at the page edge (Q20, Q49, Q50, Q52-58, Q76), one box is watermark-obscured (Q3), and five boxes print no legible letter (Q47, Q48, Q63, Q64, Q68) — no key has been guessed for any of them. A book-sourced pack of (apparently) the same printed paper already exists as ju-d-2015-2016-set5.json; this Drive-sourced pack is kept separate under the -drivepdf file suffix. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 26 of 80 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 6: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 7: key conflict - Satt key (a) recorded, answer unverified row 14: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 15: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 16: excluded (DIFFER) row 18: excluded (DIFFER) row 19: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 22: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 23: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 24: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 25: excluded (DIFFER) row 28: excluded (DIFFER) row 30: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 31: excluded (DIFFER) row 32: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (DIFFER) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (DIFFER) row 42: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (DIFFER) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 46: key conflict - Satt key (b) recorded, answer unverified row 47: key taken from Satt (b) row 48: excluded (DIFFER) row 49: excluded (DIFFER) row 50: excluded (DIFFER) row 51: excluded (DIFFER) row 52: key taken from Satt (d) row 53: key taken from Satt (a) row 54: key taken from Satt (c) row 55: excluded (DIFFER) row 56: key taken from Satt (a) row 57: excluded (DIFFER) row 58: key taken from Satt (b) row 59: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 61: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 62: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 63: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 64: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 65: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 66: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 67: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 68: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 69: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 70: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 71: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 72: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 73: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 74: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 75: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 76: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 77: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 78: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 79: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 80: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit (Faculty of Biological Sciences) 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2015-2016, SET CODE 5 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (aggregator watermark 'ADMISSION WAR' with 'তোমার সেরা গাইড' diagonal; footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner'). Each question carries a ব্যাখ্যা box with a boxed উত্তরঃ key. Renders: ocr/pages/jud1516s2/p-1..6.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi); p-1 render sha256 4032faf9e82570117bf0d3feb71ea095834e59e68eeb05b077ec33308b5ce47f. Render integrity was verified before transcription (fresh downscale read against locally generated tiles). The scan's right edge cuts through the key boxes of the right-hand columns on pp.2, 4 and 6; every affected box was checked on dedicated edge strips before being declared keyless.

examRules.sourceNote: Transcribed from the compilation's printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৫-২০১৬; D ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; boxed set label 'SET CODE: 5'; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০. বিশেষ দ্রষ্টব্য (printed): প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে; প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না; পরীক্ষার শুরুতে OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে দুটি বাক্য লিখতে হবে — ক) জীববৈচিত্র্য সংরক্ষণ অত্যাবশ্যক খ) Conservation of biodiversity is essential.
